correctness.rationale: Explicit Lindblad-to-Bloch reduction gives cubic with trace -2. Weak-coupling branch is globally minimized by the sign of p_z at the perpendicular-axis slow root. Middle branch uses the sharp depressed-cubic real-part lower bound with a unique double-root equality, and strong branch saturates the trace bound uniquely. Both thresholds agree and the EP3 Jordan cube vanishes but its square does not. Symbolic exact witnesses and 17097 finite checks corroborate the analytic argument, which alone establishes the continuum statement.

value.rationale: At fixed drive and single dephasing strength the choice of decoherence axis naturally controls asymptotic relaxation, relevant to qubit stabilization. The theorem supplies a complete continuous-control law, sharp two-threshold phase structure and attainment of the trace limit, with physical and mathematical interpretation distinct from known isolated EP locations; it is neither a test artifact nor arbitrary finite arithmetic.
